rejected_rule.statement: A mortgage bond extinguishes the usufructuary rights of the mortgagor when purchased by a third party, and any subsequent attempt to retain possession based on the original mortgage bond is invalid.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "Where a person mortgages lands which do not belong to him, but of which he has himself only a mortgage, does his mortgage interest legally become security for his debt in the hand ... The first defendant's right to the lands as usufructuary mortgage was extinguished by merger by the purchase of the bond No. 9, 793 by the plaintiff"
